        "# Install and import required libraries\n",
        "\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import seaborn as sns\n",
        "import requests\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"All libraries imported successfully!\")"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "\n",
        "# Create student dataset\n",
        "data = {\n",
        "    \"Student_ID\": [101, 102, 103, 104, 105, 106, 107, 108, 109, 103],\n",
        "    \"Name\": [\"Asha\", \"Rahul\", \"Priya\", \"Aman\", \"Sneha\",\n",
        "             \"Karan\", \"Neha\", \"Rohan\", \"Pooja\", \"Priya\"],\n",
        "    \"Math\": [85, 72, 91, 65, 78, 55, 88, 40, 95, 91],\n",
        "    \"Science\": [90, 68, 94, np.nan, 80, 60, 85, 45, 93, 94],\n",
        "    \"English\": [88, 75, 89, 70, 76, 58, 92, 50, 97, 89],\n",
        "    \"Attendance\": [95, 82, 98, 75, 88, 70, 96, 65, 99, 98]\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "# Convert into DataFrame\n",
        "df = pd.DataFrame(data)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Save dataset as CSV\n",
        "df.to_csv(\"student_performance.csv\", index=False)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Display dataset\n",
        "print(\"STUDENT PERFORMANCE DATASET\")\n",
        "print(df)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nDataset created successfully!\")\n",
        "print(\"Dataset shape:\", df.shape)"
      ],

    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# STEP 3: DATA CLEANING\n",
        "\n",
        "# Check missing values\n",
        "print(\"Missing values before cleaning:\")\n",
        "print(df.isnull().sum())\n",
        "\n",
        "# Remove duplicate student records\n",
        "df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=\"Student_ID\", keep=\"first\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Fill missing marks with the subject average\n",
        "df[\"Science\"] = df[\"Science\"].fillna(df[\"Science\"].mean())\n",
        "\n",
        "# Check missing values after cleaning\n",
        "print(\"\\nMissing values after cleaning:\")\n",
        "print(df.isnull().sum())\n",
        "\n",
        "# Display cleaned dataset\n",
        "print(\"\\nCLEANED STUDENT DATASET\")\n",
        "print(df)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nData cleaning completed successfully!\")\n",
        "print(\"Total students:\", len(df))"
      ],

          ]
        }

    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# STEP 4: DATA ANALYSIS\n",
        "\n",
        "# Calculate total marks\n",
        "df[\"Total\"] = df[\"Math\"] + df[\"Science\"] + df[\"English\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "# Calculate average marks\n",
        "df[\"Average\"] = df[\"Total\"] / 3\n",
        "\n",
        "# Calculate percentage\n",
        "df[\"Percentage\"] = (df[\"Total\"] / 300) * 100\n",
        "\n",
        "# Find pass or fail\n",
        "df[\"Result\"] = np.where(\n",
        "    (df[\"Math\"] >= 35) &\n",
        "    (df[\"Science\"] >= 35) &\n",
        "    (df[\"English\"] >= 35),\n",
        "    \"Pass\", \"Fail\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Display student analysis\n",
        "print(\"STUDENT PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS\")\n",
        "print(df[[\"Name\", \"Total\", \"Average\", \"Percentage\", \"Result\"]])\n",
        "\n",
        "# Overall statistics\n",
        "print(\"\\nOVERALL ANALYSIS\")\n",
        "print(\"Average Marks:\", round(df[\"Average\"].mean(), 2))\n",
        "print(\"Highest Total:\", df[\"Total\"].max())\n",
        "print(\"Lowest Total:\", df[\"Total\"].min())\n",
        "print(\"Total Students:\", len(df))\n",
        "print(\"Passed Students:\", (df[\"Result\"] == \"Pass\").sum())\n",
        "print(\"Failed Students:\", (df[\"Result\"] == \"Fail\").sum())\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nData analysis completed successfully!\")"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# STEP 5: DATA VISUALIZATION\n",
        "\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import seaborn as sns\n",
        "\n",
        "# Graph 1: Student-wise total marks\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))\n",
        "plt.bar(df[\"Name\"], df[\"Total\"])\n",
        "plt.title(\"Student-wise Total Marks\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Student Name\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Total Marks\")\n",
        "plt.xticks(rotation=45)\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Graph 2: Subject-wise average marks\n",
        "subject_avg = df[[\"Math\", \"Science\", \"English\"]].mean()\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(7, 5))\n",
        "subject_avg.plot(kind=\"bar\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Subject-wise Average Marks\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Subjects\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Average Marks\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Graph 3: Correlation heatmap\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(7, 5))\n",
        "sns.heatmap(\n",
        "    df[[\"Math\", \"Science\", \"English\", \"Attendance\"]].corr(),\n",
        "    annot=True,\n",
        "    cmap=\"coolwarm\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Student Performance Correlation\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Data visualization completed successfully!\")"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# STEP 6: REST API USING PYTHON\n",
        "\n",
        "import requests\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "\n",
        "# API URL\n",
        "url = \"https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users\"\n",
        "\n",
        "# Send GET request\n",
        "response = requests.get(url)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Check API response\n",
        "if response.status_code == 200:\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Convert JSON data into Python data\n",
        "    api_data = response.json()\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Convert JSON into DataFrame\n",
        "    api_df = pd.DataFrame(api_data)\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Display selected information\n",
        "    print(\"API DATA\")\n",
        "    print(api_df[[\"id\", \"name\", \"username\", \"email\"]])\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\"\\nTotal records fetched:\", len(api_df))\n",
        "    print(\"\\nREST API connected successfully!\")\n",
        "\n",
        "else:\n",
        "    print(\"API Error:\", response.status_code)"
      ],

        "\n",
        "# STEP 7: GENERATE FINAL REPORT\n",
        "\n",
        "from datetime import datetime\n",
        "\n",
        "# Calculate report details\n",
        "total_students = len(df)\n",
        "average_marks = df[\"Average\"].mean()\n",
        "highest_marks = df[\"Total\"].max()\n",
        "lowest_marks = df[\"Total\"].min()\n",
        "\n",
        "passed = (df[\"Result\"] == \"Pass\").sum()\n",
        "failed = (df[\"Result\"] == \"Fail\").sum()\n",
        "\n",
        "subject_average = df[[\"Math\", \"Science\", \"English\"]].mean()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Create report content\n",
        "report = f\"\"\"\n",
        "========================================\n",
        "   STUDENT PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS REPORT\n",
        "========================================\n",
        "\n",
        "Generated On: {datetime.now()}\n",
        "\n",
        "1. DATASET INFORMATION\n",
        "----------------------\n",
        "Total Students: {total_students}\n",
        "\n",
        "2. PERFORMANCE SUMMARY\n",
        "----------------------\n",
        "Average Marks: {average_marks:.2f}\n",
        "Highest Total Marks: {highest_marks}\n",
        "Lowest Total Marks: {lowest_marks}\n",
        "Passed Students: {passed}\n",
        "Failed Students: {failed}\n",
        "\n",
        "3. SUBJECT-WISE AVERAGE\n",
        "----------------------\n",
        "Math: {subject_average['Math']:.2f}\n",
        "Science: {subject_average['Science']:.2f}\n",
        "English: {subject_average['English']:.2f}\n",
        "\n",
        "4. STUDENT RESULTS\n",
        "------------------\n",
        "{df[['Name', 'Total', 'Percentage', 'Result']].to_string(index=False)}\n",
        "\n",

        "------------------\n",
        "API: JSONPlaceholder\n",
        "Records Fetched: {len(api_df)}\n",
        "\n",
        "========================================\n",
        "        END OF REPORT\n",
        "========================================\n",
        "\"\"\"\n",
        "\n",
        "# Save report as text file\n",
        "with open(\"Student_Analysis_Report.txt\", \"w\") as file:\n",
        "    file.write(report)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Save cleaned dataset as CSV\n",
        "df.to_csv(\"Cleaned_Student_Dataset.csv\", index=False)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(report)\n",
        "print(\"\\nFinal report generated successfully!\")\n",
        "print(\"CSV dataset saved successfully!\")"
